countries.portal: Ministry of Interior — Visa Services (Visa Inquiry & Printing)
countries.tip: Work visas issued by an employer can be checked and printed on the MOI portal before travel.

countries.portal: Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Unified Visa Platform
countries.tip: Use the official MOFA visa platform to check visa issuance and print the visa.

countries.portal: ICP Smart Services (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security)
countries.app: UAEICP app; Dubai visas: GDRFA Dubai (gdrfad.gov.ae)
countries.tip: Dubai-issued visas can also be checked on the GDRFA Dubai website.
Ask your sponsor for the visa number — Kuwait work visas are issued to the employer.
Employer-sponsored and e-visas are tracked on the Royal Oman Police eVisa portal.
Use the eVisa portal's status check with the reference number you received.
Foreign-worker permits are applied for by the employer — confirm the status with the employer and the Immigration Department.

countries.portal: Ministry of Manpower — check work pass status
countries.tip: Work Permit and S Pass applications are tracked on MOM; visit visas on ICA.
Use 'Check application status' on the Korea Visa Portal.
eVISA applications show their status in your online account.
Only use evisa.gov.tr — many look-alike sites charge extra fees.

countries.portal: Romanian eVisa portal (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
countries.app: Work permits: General Inspectorate for Immigration (igi.mai.gov.ro)
countries.tip: The employer gets the work permit (aviz de muncă) from IGI first; the long-stay visa is then tracked on the eVisa portal.

countries.portal: Welcome to Serbia — Government portal for the single work & residence permit
countries.app: Type D visa: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mfa.gov.rs); e-Government: euprava.gov.rs
countries.tip: Since 2024 the employer files a single work-and-residence permit online; its status is visible on the official portal.

countries.portal: Republic of Moldova e-Visa (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
countries.app: Work & residence permits: General Inspectorate for Migration (igm.gov.md)
countries.tip: Work permits are approved by the General Inspectorate for Migration; the visa itself is tracked on the e-Visa portal.

countries.portal: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade
countries.app: Work permits: Employment Service Agency (av.gov.mk); residence: Ministry of Interior (mvr.gov.mk)
countries.tip: There is no public online visa tracker: ask the embassy or consulate where you applied, quoting your receipt number. Work permits are issued to the employer by the Employment Service Agency.

countries.app: Some countries use TLScontact or BLS instead
need: Last name or date of birth
countries.tip: Tracking shows where your passport is; the visa decision is made by the embassy.

countries.app: UK Immigration: ID Check app / UKVI account
countries.tip: Your eVisa and status are shown in your UKVI account.

countries.portal: CEAC — Visa Status Check (U.S. Department of State)
countries.tip: Statuses: Issued, Refused (221g), Administrative Processing.
Use the IRCC application status tracker inside your secure account.
